## About
At R & E Auto Body, our passion is restoration, but there is nothing automotive we don't do. We work on everything from vintage automobiles to building cars from scratch, and all the mechanical repairs in between.
We work on all makes of foreign and domestic cars and handle auto body insurance work. Brakes, shocks and struts, tires, wheels, glass, transmissions, electrical work and computer diagnostics are all part of the job, and we offer fleet service for old or new vehicles.
The shop holds a 5 rating from 68 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collision repair and paintless dent removal: Body work after a collision, plus dent removal without repainting.
- Auto body insurance work: We handle auto body repairs that go through insurance.
- Vintage automobile restoration: Restoration work on vintage cars, custom or original.
- Complete paint jobs: Full paint work for your vehicle.
- Electrical and computer diagnostics: Tracking down electrical and computer issues on modern vehicles.
- Transmissions: Repairs on standard and automatic transmissions.
- Tires, wheels, brakes, shocks, struts and glass: Bring your vehicle in for brake problems, shocks and struts, tires, wheels and glass.
- Oil changes and tire rotations: Routine upkeep to keep your car running.
- Batteries in stock: No need to worry, we have batteries on hand.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Thursday, 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We are closed Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you do insurance work?
A: Yes, we do auto body insurance work.

Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We work on all makes of both foreign and domestic cars.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Call the shop or send us an email and we will get back to you as soon as we can.
